conditions: Run strictly one case at a time in authoritative order or approved custom order; no parallel execution.
Allocate a new unique /private/tmp parent for every case.
Re-run restored-baseline prechecks before each case.
Capture production hashes read-only before and after each case.
Stop immediately on the first unexpected state and preserve that case root.
Do not use --all even if one approval covers the full remaining sequence.

unexpected_state_examples: authoritative contract and current harness disagree on case IDs or mechanics
protected-target refusal case opens Chroma or mutates anything
mutation case leaves wrong chunk/orphan counts, extra collection, lock, WAL/SHM, or lingering process
rollback owner is not executor where executor-owned recovery is required
stop_on_first_unexpected_state_rule.required_action: Mark the case as failed-preserved, keep the disposable case root, stop the sequence, and request operator review before any next case.
